question: If the length, breadth and height of a room are 10.5 m, 8.5 m and 11 m, respectively, then what is the area (in m² ) of the four walls of the room?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The area of the four walls is the lateral surface area, which can be directly calculated using the base perimeter and height.

Area = Base Perimeter × Height = 2 × (L + B) × H

Area = 2 × (10.5 + 8.5) × 11

Area = 2 × 19 × 11 = 418 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 418 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height (H) = 11 m

**Formula Used:**
